thread:
jade: quick UX question — when a user saves a query from a specific route with a model selected (e.g., route=/checkout, model=gpt-redwood-1.3b), should the saved query: lock to the route+model by default, or be saved as a generic filter set that can be applied anywhere? :thinking:

mike: +1 for locking to context by default. Most saves are for a specific investigation and people expect to come back in the same context. we can expose a 'Make reusable/global' toggle on save.

sasha: agree on default lock. we need to be explicit about what "lock" means — is it a hard binding (only shown when on that route) or a soft hint (visible everywhere but annotated)?

alana: practical edge: some routes are aliases (e.g., /checkout -> combined-checkout), users will be confused if saved query disappears. show an affordance: "Applies to: route-checkout (alias)" and allow fallback to alias mappings. :lock:

pranay: schema thought: savedQuery should include a `scope` enum: ["route", "global"], plus optional `route_id`, `route_aliases`, `pinned_model`, and `filters`. example below.

jade: quick sketch:
```
{
  "name": "Checkout high latency - GPT",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "route-checkout-v2",
  "route_aliases": ["/checkout"],
  "pinned_model": "gpt-redwood-1.3b",
  "filters": {"latency_ms": ">200", "status": "error"}
}
```

mike: on the API contract, let's keep `scope` optional and default to `route` when saved from a route view to avoid breaking clients. and add `visibility` for share settings (team/private/org).

sasha: permissions corner cases: if someone in team A saves a route-scoped query and team B also has access to that route, should B see it? my vote: yes if route accessible; visibility governs cross-team sharing. will write test matrix.

deploy-bot: saved query created by jade at 2750001111 (automated note) :white_check_mark:

alana: UX proposal for the save modal: header shows context pill (Route: /checkout | Model: gpt-redwood-1.3b), checkbox "Make reusable across routes", and small copy: "Saved queries default to the current route and model. Toggle to make global."

jade: will prototype the modal. mike can you sketch the minimal API fields so I can wire the save call?

mike: yep — I'll put up a draft PR for `POST /api/saved_queries` with fields: name, scope, route_id?, model_id?, filters, visibility. will include migration plan to backfill older saves as route-scoped by default.

sasha: also add telemetry events: `saved_query.created` with tags scope, route_id, model_id; and `saved_query.applied` with context so we can measure reuse vs single-route-only.

jade: perfect. timeline: prototype modal + screenshots by EOD, mike PR tomorrow, sasha test/telemetry matrix next week.

mike: one more micro-decision — when a route-scoped saved query references a model that has been rolled out/removed, we should surface a fallback (e.g., "model unavailable — use latest compatible"). annotate saved query with model compatibility metadata during apply.

jade: noted. adding fallback hint to the proto. thanks all!
